title: 2021-22 Panini Prizm Red White & Blue Prizm #64 Harrison Barnes Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021-22 Panini Prizm sports trading card features Sacramento Kings player Harrison Barnes, card number 64. It belongs to the Red White & Blue Prizm variety in the Panini manufacturer's set. The card is in excellent condition and is perfect for any basketball fan or collector.

The card is a great addition to any collection and is ideal for those who follow the National Basketball Association (NBA). It has a base set feature and is perfect for trading with other collectors. This item is not autographed and is a must-have for anyone who loves sports trading cards.
